name: Folbum
description: Turn your MOS Photos folders into albums

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your Folbum account, settings, sync history and saved MOS sign-in. Keep it private and back it up.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Your MOS storage, read-only at the same path. Only the optional Dashboard disk check reads it; Folbum never changes your photos.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your other MOS disks, read-only at the same path, like /media/HDD-Storage/Gallery. Only the optional Dashboard disk check reads it.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Folbum web app, published on host as 6799

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DATA_DIR
variables.description: Where Folbum keeps its account, settings and sync history inside the container. Leave it as /app/data.
